mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lingxing_sta_inbound_plan ( record_key, inbound_plan_id, sid, plan_name, status, position_type, gmt_create, gmt_modified, sync_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{recordKey}, #{inboundPlanId}, #{sid}, #{planName}, #{status}, #{positionType}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified}, #{syncTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inbound_plan_id = VALUES(inbound_plan_id), sid = VALUES(sid), plan_name = VALUES(plan_name), status = VALUES(status), position_type = VALUES(position_type), gmt_create = VALUES(gmt_create), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time), update_time = VALUES(update_time), id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)

INSERT INTO lingxing_sta_inbound_plan_item ( record_key, inbound_plan_id, item_index, asin, fnsku, msku, parent_asin, product_name, quantity, sku, title, url, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.recordKey}, #{item.inboundPlanId}, #{item.itemIndex}, #{item.asin}, #{item.fnsku}, #{item.msku}, #{item.parentAsin}, #{item.productName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.sku}, #{item.title}, #{item.url}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )

INSERT INTO lingxing_sta_inbound_plan_shipment ( record_key, inbound_plan_id, shipment_index, shipment_id, shipment_confirmation_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.recordKey}, #{item.inboundPlanId}, #{item.shipmentIndex}, #{item.shipmentId}, #{item.shipmentConfirmationId}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE record_key = VALUES(record_key), inbound_plan_id = VALUES(inbound_plan_id), shipment_index = VALUES(shipment_index), shipment_id = VALUES(shipment_id), shipment_confirmation_id = VALUES(shipment_confirmation_id), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT p.record_key AS recordKey, p.inbound_plan_id AS inboundPlanId, p.sid AS sid, s.shipment_id AS shipmentId, s.shipment_confirmation_id AS shipmentConfirmationId FROM lingxing_sta_inbound_plan_shipment s INNER JOIN lingxing_sta_inbound_plan p ON p.record_key = s.record_key WHERE s.shipment_confirmation_id = #{shipmentNo} OR s.shipment_id = #{shipmentNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.shipment_confirmation_id = #{shipmentNo} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.gmt_modified DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT msku FROM lingxing_sta_inbound_plan_item WHERE record_key = #{recordKey} AND (sku = #{skuOrMsku} OR msku = #{skuOrMsku}) AND msku IS NOT NULL AND msku <> '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN msku = #{skuOrMsku} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, msku
